shared_conventions.axis: Y up, right-handed; map top = -Z; yaw 0 faces +Z, yaw +pi/2 faces +X
shared_conventions.actor_anchor: keyframe position is the ground/foot anchor; a lying or prone body extends its full height along the head direction from that anchor
shared_conventions.lying_yaw: for lie/prone the head points (-sin yaw, 0, -cos yaw); for stand/sit/kneel/crouch the face points (sin yaw, 0, cos yaw)
shared_conventions.time_base: group-internal seconds throughout; camera start/duration_s match shot_list durations exactly
shared_conventions.scene_scale: bible/scenes/<sid>/whitebox.json dimensions and objects used as delivered; nothing rescaled

shared_conventions.identity_colours: episode-fixed, assigned by the host: CHAR-alice #e63946, CHAR-alice-sister #1d78d8, CRE-001 #2ea043, CHAR-white-rabbit #f59e0b; no collisions.
